changelog:
• Optional anonymous usage statistics, with an off switch in Settings → Privacy. No account, no name, no email, no advertising ID, no device serial, no location, and no IP address stored.
• Network hardening: unencrypted HTTP is now refused everywhere except the in-app playback server running on your own device at 127.0.0.1.
• Removed two hardcoded fallback backends. One was already returning errors for every request.
• Update screen now shows the full list of changes, and Settings shows what's new in the version you're running.
